extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern’s GREAT Life Advantage 4 is described as a whole-of-life, regular premium investment-linked (ILP) plan that aims to provide “lifetime protection against Death, Total and Permanent Disability and Terminal Illness.” The brochure also states that you can enhance coverage with “optional riders” that provide extra financial support for critical illness at “early, intermediate and critical stages,” but it does not provide rider names or specific payout amounts for these critical illness stages in the provided text. The plan includes a Child Cover Benefit that automatically covers your child(ren) and pays a S$20,000 payout for a “major life-impacting event.” Coverage chosen is guaranteed for the first 10 years. The policy offers flexibility to increase coverage at “eight life’s milestone events” without medical assessment, and allows single premium top-ups and withdrawals. Investment options include three GreatLink Dynamic Portfolios—Secure, Balanced, and Growth—with equity exposure ranges stated for each.
quality_notes: A large portion of the provided Markdown appears corrupted/garbled, reducing confidence for extracting age/limits/premium mechanics beyond what remains readable.
Critical illness protection is mentioned as optional riders at early/intermediate/critical stages, but no rider names and no explicit benefit amounts are clearly stated in the provided text.
Some numerical details beyond S$100/month and the Child Cover Benefit S$20,000 are unreadable in the provided material.

policies.quick_summary: Whole-of-life regular premium investment-linked plan providing lifetime protection against Death, Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) and Terminal Illness, with optional critical-illness rider protection at early, intermediate and critical stages (rider names and payout amounts not stated). Includes Child Cover Benefit of S$20,000 and guarantees chosen coverage for the first 10 years; offers coverage increases at eight life milestone events without medical assessment and allows single premium top-ups/withdrawals. Investment choices include GreatLink Dynamic Portfolios (Secure/Balanced/Growth).

policies.eligibility_notes: Coverage can be increased at eight life’s milestone events without medical assessment (for those events).
policies.coverage_term_description: Whole life coverage; coverage chosen is guaranteed for the first 10 years.
important_caveats: The brochure mentions optional critical illness protection via riders at early/intermediate/critical stages, but no rider names or specific payout amounts are stated in the provided text.
The investment-linked portion uses GreatLink Dynamic Portfolios (Secure/Balanced/Growth), and the brochure includes risk-level statements for the portfolios (high degree of risk for Balanced/Growth).
